# Camp Resource: Live Bait Barrel

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Apr 11, 2025
- 2 min read

Updated: Jun 21, 2025

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_deaaa7a471764ccab1279f11e1b4f323~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

Have a fresh selection of fishing bait available in your C.A.M.P. to help you catch some fish.

Generates Fishing Bait.

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Live Bait Barrel__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_aed232c3aff947a1b37c12f6613dacd8~mv2.jpg)

**Produces**

Bait - Common

Bait - Improved

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

None

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resources

**Materials required to craft resource**

1x Steel

3x Wood

**Holds**

10 Pounds

Bait - Common - 0.05 pounds

Bait - Improved - 0.05 pounds

**Obtainable via**

Real World Money Bundle from your platform's shop

**Atomic Angler Bundle**

Includes:

Hydro Tech Exo Power Armour

Appalachian Contessa Prefab

Live Bait Barrel

Floating Bouy Set

Charmcaster Fishing Rod

Title Prefix: Contessa

Title Suffix: Buoy

**Produces X amount per**

10 minutes and 12 seconds

**Lockable**

Yes

**Power Required**

No

**Flamingo Units**

2 Flamingo Units

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_37a8ee666027440d97d4c2ae0b5393e1~mv2.png)
